figures.alt: 2015 至 2025 年年度发文与引用趋势
figures.caption: Figure 3. Annual publication and citation patterns, 2015–2025. (a) Annual publication trends; (b) annual citation trends; (c) annual publication counts and citation weights for selected leading regions across continents.
